title: Yummy Flambe Thai Cherry Nam Prik
description: A buttery, glassy cherry jelly infused with spicy Thai chili paste and served on slate tile for a festive, ayurvedic-friendly delight.
instructions: Crush cherries into juice using a blender and strain to remove skins and pits.
In a saucepan, combine cherry juice, sugar, coconut milk, butter, and water; heat until butter melts and sugar dissolves.
Whisk agar-agar powder into the mixture; bring to a rolling boil for one minute while stirring constantly.
Remove from heat and let the mixture cool to forty degrees Celsius, stirring occasionally to prevent clumping.
Pour the cooled mixture into a shallow slate tile and refrigerate for at least two hours until set into a glassy jelly.
While the jelly sets, whisk lime juice, fish sauce, chili paste, grated ginger, minced garlic, and sesame oil in a bowl until smooth.
Slice the set jelly into wedges and drizzle with the spicy glaze before serving on slate tile.
